title: Benchmarking Cyberattack Detection in Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure with Benign User Updates
abstract: arXiv:2608.11286v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cyberattack detection in electric vehicle charging infrastructure is complicated by legitimate post-activation revisions to requested energy and departure time. Charging manipulation attacks can exploit the same interface and variables; therefore, detecting a request change alone does not establish malicious intent. This paper develops a leakage-controlled session-level benchmark that preserves the ordered inputs of real Adaptive Charging Network (ACN) sessions and models legitimate revisions as normal behavior. A fixed pool keeps each generated attack in its source session's split and contains six physically motivated attacks and their coordinated variants. We compare 22 profile-only, transition-aware, and context-stratified model families under common source-grouped folds, attack data, and operating constraints. translated_title: 电动汽车充电基础设施中网络攻击检测的基准测试：考虑用户良性更新
translated_abstract: 电动汽车充电基础设施中的网络攻击检测因用户激活后对请求能量和出发时间的合法修订而变得复杂。充电操纵攻击可以利用相同的接口和变量；因此，仅检测请求变化并不能确定恶意意图。本文开发了一个泄漏控制的会话级基准，该基准保留了真实自适应充电网络（ACN）会话的有序输入，并将合法修订建模为正常行为。固定池确保每个生成的攻击保留在其源会话的划分中，并包含六种物理动机攻击及其协同变体。我们在常见的源分组折叠、攻击数据和操作约束下比较了22种仅配置文件、状态感知和上下文分层模型族。提出的双分支掩码自编码器（Masked-AE）转换增强模型评估当前请求是否正常。
tldr: 本文提出一个泄漏控制的会话级基准和双分支掩码自编码器模型，以区分电动汽车充电中的良性用户修订与操纵攻击，解决仅检测请求变化无法识别恶意意图的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a leakage-controlled session-level benchmark and a Dual-Branch Masked-Autoencoder model to distinguish benign user revisions from manipulation attacks in EV charging, addressing the challenge that detecting request changes alone cannot identify malicious intent.
